name: arex-acceso-comercial
title_zh: 选定市场里，产品该走哪条渠道、找哪几个枢纽
tagline_zh: 不是给你一份泛泛的渠道清单，而是先锁死一个市场，再倒推该走哪条路、在哪几个枢纽布点。
tagline_en: Locks one market first, then derives the channel, the hubs to cover, and the exact filters that disqualify the.
desc_en: Diseña la entrada comercial de un producto en un mercado seleccionado, incluyendo canal, hubs y criterios para cualificar socios.
why_zh: 它把「进哪个市场」当成约束条件而不是结论，渠道、枢纽、合作方标准全部从这一个市场反推。
why_en: It treats market choice as a constraint, not a conclusion—channel, hubs, and partner criteria all derive from that one market.
limit_zh: 只做商业进入路径的设计，不替你验证市场是否真实存在需求；渠道和枢纽靠你提供或它推断，没有本地数据源就只是框架。
limit_en: Designs the go-to-market path only; it won't validate real demand. Channels and hubs come from your input or inference—no local data source means.
title_en: Pick a market, then map its channel, hubs, and partner.
